notes.note: Heading of the group of live metrics tiles with the figures of the DHCP role.
Title of the tile with the DHCP leases granted per second.
Hint under the leases tile: what counts as a granted lease.

segment.source: Requests answered with an ACK: new, renewed and rebound leases

notes.note: Title of the tile with the 99th percentile of the time from a DHCP REQUEST to its ACK.
Hint under the REQUEST to ACK tile while there are ACKs.

segment.source: Includes the commit of the lease before the ACK leaves

notes.note: Hint under the REQUEST to ACK tile when no ACK was sent in the last second.

segment.source: No ACK in the last second

notes.note: Title of the tile with the number of active DHCP leases.
Hint under the active leases tile: the addresses held back after a conflict or a DECLINE.

segment.source: {abandoned, plural, =0 {No address held back after a conflict} one {# address held back after a conflict or DECLINE} other {# addresses held back after a conflict or DECLINE}}

notes.note: Title of the tile with how full the fullest DHCP pool is, with the three fullest scopes listed.
Hint under the pools tile: how many scopes have a pool.

segment.source: {scopes, plural, one {# scope with a pool} other {# scopes with a pool}}

notes.note: Hint under the pools tile when no scope has a pool.

segment.source: No scope has a pool yet

notes.note: Title of the tile with the DHCP NAKs sent and DECLINEs received per second.
Hint under the NAKs and DECLINEs tile: what each means.

segment.source: A NAK refuses an address of another network; a DECLINE reports an address in use

notes.note: Row of the NAKs and DECLINEs tile: NAKs sent.
Row of the NAKs and DECLINEs tile: DECLINEs received.
Title of the tile with the DNS names the DHCP server writes for its clients (DDNS), per second.
Hint under the DDNS tile: the requests waiting, and those with nothing to write or dropped from a full queue, per second.

segment.source: {queue, plural, one {# waiting} other {# waiting}}, {skipped}/s skipped, {dropped}/s dropped

notes.note: Row of the DDNS tile: names written.
Row of the DDNS tile: names removed on release or expiry.
Row of the DDNS tile: names refused, for example by name protection.
Row of the DDNS tile: writes that failed after the retries.
